headlines.title: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
headlines.summary: As backlash grows over Flock's AI surveillance cameras, Texas Governor Greg Abbott has frozen state spending on them. The move came just ahead of the publication of a Texas Tribune investigation that revealed the state spent over $30 million on Flock cameras.

concept.title: Tokens & Context Windows
concept.body: Models read and bill in 'tokens' (word fragments), and a 'context window' caps how much they consider at once. Bigger context lets you feed more, but cost and latency rise with it.
concept.takeaway: Watch cost-per-task, not just cost-per-token — verbose prompts add up fast.
